"""Stage 2 Part A: deterministic per-task features. No LLM, no embeddings.

Reads data/processed/tools.jsonl and tasks_resolved.jsonl and writes
data/processed/tasks_tagged.jsonl with feature fields. The judgment field is
left as null here and filled by the Part B labeler (merged by task_id).

Run: python -m toolprune.task_features
"""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROC_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "processed"

OVERLAP_THRESHOLD = 0.10  # fixed before any system is scored; do not tune
MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN = 3
NAME_JACCARD_MIN = 0.5

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """a an and are as at be but by can do does for from had has have how i in into is it
    its me my of on or our please that the their them then there these this to us was we
    what when where which who why will with would you your want need using use make
    get give show find tell let just also any all some each one two about over under
    should could may might must shall being been were am out up down off than too very
    s t""".split()
)


def stem(token: str) -> str:
    """Light suffix stripping. Deliberately simple and applied identically everywhere."""
    for suffix, minimum in (("ing", 5), ("ed", 4), ("es", 4), ("s", 4)):
        if token.endswith(suffix) and len(token) >= minimum:
            return token[: -len(suffix)]
    return token


def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    raw = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())
    return {stem(t) for t in raw if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1}


def name_tokens(name: str) -> set[str]:
    """Split identifiers on _, -, spaces, dots and camelCase boundaries."""
    spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", name)
    parts = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", spaced.lower())
    return {stem(p) for p in parts if p not in STOPWORDS}


def overlap_ratio(question: str, gold_tools: list[dict]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
    q = content_tokens(question)
    if not q:
        return 0.0, 0, 0
    doc_terms: set[str] = set()
    for tool in gold_tools:
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["name"])
        doc_terms |= content_tokens(tool.get("description") or "")
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["server"])
    hit = q & doc_terms
    return len(hit) / len(q), len(hit), len(q)


def jaccard(a: set[str], b: set[str]) -> float:
    if not a or not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)


def schema_neighbors(gold: dict, tools: list[dict], by_name: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[dict]:
    neighbors = []
    seen = set()
    for other in by_name.get(gold["name"], []):
        if other["id"] != gold["id"] and other["server"] != gold["server"]:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "same_name", "score": 1.0})
            seen.add(other["id"])
    g_tokens = name_tokens(gold["name"])
    for other in tools:
        if other["id"] == gold["id"] or other["id"] in seen:
            continue
        score = jaccard(g_tokens, name_tokens(other["name"]))
        if score >= NAME_JACCARD_MIN:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "name_token_overlap", "score": round(score, 3)})
    return neighbors


def hints(tool: dict) -> tuple[bool | None, bool | None]:
    ann = tool.get("annotations") or {}
    return ann.get("readOnlyHint"), ann.get("destructiveHint")


def main() -> None:
    tools = [json.loads(line) for line in (PROC_DIR / "tools.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in (PROC_DIR / "tasks_resolved.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    by_id = {t["id"]: t for t in tools}
    by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for t in tools:
        by_name.setdefault(t["name"], []).append(t)

    rows = []
    n_low = n_multi = n_shared = 0
    for task in tasks:
        gold = [by_id[g] for g in task["gold_ids"] if g is not None]
        ratio, hit, qn = overlap_ratio(task["question"], gold)
        low = ratio <= OVERLAP_THRESHOLD
        multi = task["n_gold"] >= MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN
        shared = any(g["name_collision_count"] > 1 for g in gold)
        n_low += low
        n_multi += multi
        n_shared += shared

        gold_detail = []
        for g in gold:
            ro, de = hints(g)
            gold_detail.append({"tool_id": g["id"], "name_collision_count": g["name_collision_count"],
                                "read_only_hint": ro, "destructive_hint": de})

        neighbors = {g["id"]: schema_neighbors(g, tools, by_name) for g in gold}
        rows.append({
            "task_id": task["task_id"],
            "question": task["question"],
            "category": task["category"],
            "steps": task["steps"],
            "gold_names": task["gold_names"],
            "gold_ids": task["gold_ids"],
            "resolution": task["resolution"],
            "n_gold": task["n_gold"],
            "fully_resolved": task["fully_resolved"],
            "features": {
                "overlap_ratio": round(ratio, 4),
                "overlap_count": hit,
                "question_content_tokens": qn,
                "low_overlap": low,
                "multi_capability": multi,
                "shared_name": shared,
                "gold_tool_hints": gold_detail,
                "schema_neighbors": neighbors,
                "n_resolved_gold": len(gold),
            },
            "judgment": None,
        })

    out = PROC_DIR / "tasks_tagged.jsonl"
    with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {len(rows)} rows to {out}")
    print(f"low_overlap (ratio <= {OVERLAP_THRESHOLD}): {n_low}")
    print(f"multi_capability (n_gold >= {MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN}): {n_multi}")
    print(f"shared_name: {n_shared}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROC_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "processed"

OVERLAP_THRESHOLD = 0.10  # fixed before any system is scored; do not tune
MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN = 3
NAME_JACCARD_MIN = 0.5

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """a an and are as at be but by can do does for from had has have how i in into is it
    its me my of on or our please that the their them then there these this to us was we
    what when where which who why will with would you your want need using use make
    get give show find tell let just also any all some each one two about over under
    should could may might must shall being been were am out up down off than too very
    s t""".split()
)


def stem(token: str) -> str:
    """Light suffix stripping. Deliberately simple and applied identically everywhere."""
    for suffix, minimum in (("ing", 5), ("ed", 4), ("es", 4), ("s", 4)):
        if token.endswith(suffix) and len(token) >= minimum:
            return token[: -len(suffix)]
    return token


def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    raw = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())
    return {stem(t) for t in raw if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1}


def name_tokens(name: str) -> set[str]:
    """Split identifiers on _, -, spaces, dots and camelCase boundaries."""
    spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", name)
    parts = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", spaced.lower())
    return {stem(p) for p in parts if p not in STOPWORDS}


def overlap_ratio(question: str, gold_tools: list[dict]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
    q = content_tokens(question)
    if not q:
        return 0.0, 0, 0
    doc_terms: set[str] = set()
    for tool in gold_tools:
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["name"])
        doc_terms |= content_tokens(tool.get("description") or "")
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["server"])
    hit = q & doc_terms
    return len(hit) / len(q), len(hit), len(q)


def jaccard(a: set[str], b: set[str]) -> float:
    if not a or not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)


def schema_neighbors(gold: dict, tools: list[dict], by_name: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[dict]:
    neighbors = []
    seen = set()
    for other in by_name.get(gold["name"], []):
        if other["id"] != gold["id"] and other["server"] != gold["server"]:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "same_name", "score": 1.0})
            seen.add(other["id"])
    g_tokens = name_tokens(gold["name"])
    for other in tools:
        if other["id"] == gold["id"] or other["id"] in seen:
            continue
        score = jaccard(g_tokens, name_tokens(other["name"]))
        if score >= NAME_JACCARD_MIN:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "name_token_overlap", "score": round(score, 3)})
    return neighbors

    ann = tool.get("annotations") or {}
    return ann.get("readOnlyHint"), ann.get("destructiveHint")

"""Stage 2 Part A: deterministic per-task features. No LLM, no embeddings.

Reads data/processed/tools.jsonl and tasks_resolved.jsonl and writes
data/processed/tasks_tagged.jsonl with feature fields. The judgment field is
left as null here and filled by the Part B labeler (merged by task_id).

Run: python -m toolprune.task_features
"""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROC_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "processed"

OVERLAP_THRESHOLD = 0.10  # fixed before any system is scored; do not tune
MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN = 3
NAME_JACCARD_MIN = 0.5

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """a an and are as at be but by can do does for from had has have how i in into is it
    its me my of on or our please that the their them then there these this to us was we
    what when where which who why will with would you your want need using use make
    get give show find tell let just also any all some each one two about over under
    should could may might must shall being been were am out up down off than too very
    s t""".split()
)


def stem(token: str) -> str:
    """Light suffix stripping. Deliberately simple and applied identically everywhere."""
    for suffix, minimum in (("ing", 5), ("ed", 4), ("es", 4), ("s", 4)):
        if token.endswith(suffix) and len(token) >= minimum:
            return token[: -len(suffix)]
    return token


def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    raw = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())
    return {stem(t) for t in raw if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1}


def name_tokens(name: str) -> set[str]:
    """Split identifiers on _, -, spaces, dots and camelCase boundaries."""
    spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", name)
    parts = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", spaced.lower())
    return {stem(p) for p in parts if p not in STOPWORDS}


def overlap_ratio(question: str, gold_tools: list[dict]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
    q = content_tokens(question)
    if not q:
        return 0.0, 0, 0
    doc_terms: set[str] = set()
    for tool in gold_tools:
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["name"])
        doc_terms |= content_tokens(tool.get("description") or "")
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["server"])
    hit = q & doc_terms
    return len(hit) / len(q), len(hit), len(q)


def jaccard(a: set[str], b: set[str]) -> float:
    if not a or not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)


def schema_neighbors(gold: dict, tools: list[dict], by_name: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[dict]:
    neighbors = []
    seen = set()
    for other in by_name.get(gold["name"], []):
        if other["id"] != gold["id"] and other["server"] != gold["server"]:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "same_name", "score": 1.0})
            seen.add(other["id"])
    g_tokens = name_tokens(gold["name"])
    for other in tools:
        if other["id"] == gold["id"] or other["id"] in seen:
            continue
        score = jaccard(g_tokens, name_tokens(other["name"]))
        if score >= NAME_JACCARD_MIN:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "name_token_overlap", "score": round(score, 3)})
    return neighbors


def hints(tool: dict) -> tuple[bool | None, bool | None]:
    ann = tool.get("annotations") or {}
    return ann.get("readOnlyHint"), ann.get("destructiveHint")


def main() -> None:
    tools = [json.loads(line) for line in (PROC_DIR / "tools.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in (PROC_DIR / "tasks_resolved.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    by_id = {t["id"]: t for t in tools}
    by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for t in tools:
        by_name.setdefault(t["name"], []).append(t)

    rows = []
    n_low = n_multi = n_shared = 0
    for task in tasks:
        gold = [by_id[g] for g in task["gold_ids"] if g is not None]
        ratio, hit, qn = overlap_ratio(task["question"], gold)
        low = ratio <= OVERLAP_THRESHOLD
        multi = task["n_gold"] >= MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN
        shared = any(g["name_collision_count"] > 1 for g in gold)
        n_low += low
        n_multi += multi
        n_shared += shared

        gold_detail = []
        for g in gold:
            ro, de = hints(g)
            gold_detail.append({"tool_id": g["id"], "name_collision_count": g["name_collision_count"],
                                "read_only_hint": ro, "destructive_hint": de})

        neighbors = {g["id"]: schema_neighbors(g, tools, by_name) for g in gold}
        rows.append({
            "task_id": task["task_id"],
            "question": task["question"],
            "category": task["category"],
            "steps": task["steps"],
            "gold_names": task["gold_names"],
            "gold_ids": task["gold_ids"],
            "resolution": task["resolution"],
            "n_gold": task["n_gold"],
            "fully_resolved": task["fully_resolved"],
            "features": {
                "overlap_ratio": round(ratio, 4),
                "overlap_count": hit,
                "question_content_tokens": qn,
                "low_overlap": low,
                "multi_capability": multi,
                "shared_name": shared,
                "gold_tool_hints": gold_detail,
                "schema_neighbors": neighbors,
                "n_resolved_gold": len(gold),
            },
            "judgment": None,
        })

    out = PROC_DIR / "tasks_tagged.jsonl"
    with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {len(rows)} rows to {out}")
    print(f"low_overlap (ratio <= {OVERLAP_THRESHOLD}): {n_low}")
    print(f"multi_capability (n_gold >= {MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN}): {n_multi}")
    print(f"shared_name: {n_shared}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Stage 2 Part A: deterministic per-task features. No LLM, no embeddings.

Reads data/processed/tools.jsonl and tasks_resolved.jsonl and writes
data/processed/tasks_tagged.jsonl with feature fields. The judgment field is
left as null here and filled by the Part B labeler (merged by task_id).

Run: python -m toolprune.task_features
"""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROC_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "processed"

OVERLAP_THRESHOLD = 0.10  # fixed before any system is scored; do not tune
MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN = 3
NAME_JACCARD_MIN = 0.5

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """a an and are as at be but by can do does for from had has have how i in into is it
    its me my of on or our please that the their them then there these this to us was we
    what when where which who why will with would you your want need using use make
    get give show find tell let just also any all some each one two about over under
    should could may might must shall being been were am out up down off than too very
    s t""".split()
)


def stem(token: str) -> str:
    """Light suffix stripping. Deliberately simple and applied identically everywhere."""
    for suffix, minimum in (("ing", 5), ("ed", 4), ("es", 4), ("s", 4)):
        if token.endswith(suffix) and len(token) >= minimum:
            return token[: -len(suffix)]
    return token


CJK_RUN = re.compile(r"[一-鿿]+")
ASCII_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")


def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """ASCII words (stemmed, stopwords dropped) plus CJK character bigrams.

    CJK text has no spaces, so each run is split into overlapping bigrams
    (a single-character run stays as one token). Without this, Chinese
    questions and docs would score zero overlap by construction.
    """
    lowered = text.lower()
    out = {stem(t) for t in ASCII_TOKEN.findall(lowered) if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1}
    for run in CJK_RUN.findall(text):
        if len(run) == 1:
            out.add(run)
        else:
            out.update(run[i:i + 2] for i in range(len(run) - 1))
    return out


def name_tokens(name: str) -> set[str]:
    """Split identifiers on _, -, spaces, dots and camelCase boundaries."""
    spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", name)
    parts = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", spaced.lower())
    return {stem(p) for p in parts if p not in STOPWORDS}


def overlap_ratio(question: str, gold_tools: list[dict]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
    q = content_tokens(question)
    if not q:
        return 0.0, 0, 0
    doc_terms: set[str] = set()
    for tool in gold_tools:
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["name"])
        doc_terms |= content_tokens(tool.get("description") or "")
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["server"])
    hit = q & doc_terms
    return len(hit) / len(q), len(hit), len(q)


def jaccard(a: set[str], b: set[str]) -> float:
    if not a or not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)


def schema_neighbors(gold: dict, tools: list[dict], by_name: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[dict]:
    neighbors = []
    seen = set()
    for other in by_name.get(gold["name"], []):
        if other["id"] != gold["id"] and other["server"] != gold["server"]:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "same_name", "score": 1.0})
            seen.add(other["id"])
    g_tokens = name_tokens(gold["name"])
    for other in tools:
        if other["id"] == gold["id"] or other["id"] in seen:
            continue
        score = jaccard(g_tokens, name_tokens(other["name"]))
        if score >= NAME_JACCARD_MIN:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "name_token_overlap", "score": round(score, 3)})
    return neighbors


def hints(tool: dict) -> tuple[bool | None, bool | None]:
    ann = tool.get("annotations") or {}
    return ann.get("readOnlyHint"), ann.get("destructiveHint")


def main() -> None:

"""Stage 2 Part A: deterministic per-task features. No LLM, no embeddings.

Reads data/processed/tools.jsonl and tasks_resolved.jsonl and writes
data/processed/tasks_tagged.jsonl with feature fields. The judgment field is
left as null here and filled by the Part B labeler (merged by task_id).

Run: python -m toolprune.task_features
"""

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROC_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "processed"

OVERLAP_THRESHOLD = 0.10  # fixed before any system is scored; do not tune
MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN = 3
NAME_JACCARD_MIN = 0.5

STOPWORDS = frozenset(
    """a an and are as at be but by can do does for from had has have how i in into is it
    its me my of on or our please that the their them then there these this to us was we
    what when where which who why will with would you your want need using use make
    get give show find tell let just also any all some each one two about over under
    should could may might must shall being been were am out up down off than too very
    s t""".split()
)


def stem(token: str) -> str:
    """Light suffix stripping. Deliberately simple and applied identically everywhere."""
    for suffix, minimum in (("ing", 5), ("ed", 4), ("es", 4), ("s", 4)):
        if token.endswith(suffix) and len(token) >= minimum:
            return token[: -len(suffix)]
    return token


CJK_RUN = re.compile(r"[一-鿿]+")
ASCII_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")


def content_tokens(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """ASCII words (stemmed, stopwords dropped) plus CJK character bigrams.

    CJK text has no spaces, so each run is split into overlapping bigrams
    (a single-character run stays as one token). Without this, Chinese
    questions and docs would score zero overlap by construction.
    """
    lowered = text.lower()
    out = {stem(t) for t in ASCII_TOKEN.findall(lowered) if t not in STOPWORDS and len(t) > 1}
    for run in CJK_RUN.findall(text):
        if len(run) == 1:
            out.add(run)
        else:
            out.update(run[i:i + 2] for i in range(len(run) - 1))
    return out


def name_tokens(name: str) -> set[str]:
    """Split identifiers on _, -, spaces, dots and camelCase boundaries."""
    spaced = re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1 \2", name)
    parts = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", spaced.lower())
    return {stem(p) for p in parts if p not in STOPWORDS}


def overlap_ratio(question: str, gold_tools: list[dict]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
    q = content_tokens(question)
    if not q:
        return 0.0, 0, 0
    doc_terms: set[str] = set()
    for tool in gold_tools:
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["name"])
        doc_terms |= content_tokens(tool.get("description") or "")
        doc_terms |= name_tokens(tool["server"])
    hit = q & doc_terms
    return len(hit) / len(q), len(hit), len(q)


def jaccard(a: set[str], b: set[str]) -> float:
    if not a or not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)


def schema_neighbors(gold: dict, tools: list[dict], by_name: dict[str, list[dict]]) -> list[dict]:
    neighbors = []
    seen = set()
    for other in by_name.get(gold["name"], []):
        if other["id"] != gold["id"] and other["server"] != gold["server"]:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "same_name", "score": 1.0})
            seen.add(other["id"])
    g_tokens = name_tokens(gold["name"])
    for other in tools:
        if other["id"] == gold["id"] or other["id"] in seen:
            continue
        score = jaccard(g_tokens, name_tokens(other["name"]))
        if score >= NAME_JACCARD_MIN:
            neighbors.append({"tool_id": other["id"], "reason": "name_token_overlap", "score": round(score, 3)})
    return neighbors


def hints(tool: dict) -> tuple[bool | None, bool | None]:
    ann = tool.get("annotations") or {}
    return ann.get("readOnlyHint"), ann.get("destructiveHint")


def main() -> None:
    tools = [json.loads(line) for line in (PROC_DIR / "tools.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    tasks = [json.loads(line) for line in (PROC_DIR / "tasks_resolved.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    by_id = {t["id"]: t for t in tools}
    by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for t in tools:
        by_name.setdefault(t["name"], []).append(t)

    rows = []
    n_low = n_multi = n_shared = 0
    for task in tasks:
        gold = [by_id[g] for g in task["gold_ids"] if g is not None]
        ratio, hit, qn = overlap_ratio(task["question"], gold)
        low = ratio <= OVERLAP_THRESHOLD
        multi = task["n_gold"] >= MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN
        shared = any(g["name_collision_count"] > 1 for g in gold)
        n_low += low
        n_multi += multi
        n_shared += shared

        gold_detail = []
        for g in gold:
            ro, de = hints(g)
            gold_detail.append({"tool_id": g["id"], "name_collision_count": g["name_collision_count"],
                                "read_only_hint": ro, "destructive_hint": de})

        neighbors = {g["id"]: schema_neighbors(g, tools, by_name) for g in gold}
        rows.append({
            "task_id": task["task_id"],
            "question": task["question"],
            "category": task["category"],
            "steps": task["steps"],
            "gold_names": task["gold_names"],
            "gold_ids": task["gold_ids"],
            "resolution": task["resolution"],
            "n_gold": task["n_gold"],
            "fully_resolved": task["fully_resolved"],
            "features": {
                "overlap_ratio": round(ratio, 4),
                "overlap_count": hit,
                "question_content_tokens": qn,
                "low_overlap": low,
                "multi_capability": multi,
                "shared_name": shared,
                "gold_tool_hints": gold_detail,
                "schema_neighbors": neighbors,
                "n_resolved_gold": len(gold),
            },
            "judgment": None,
        })

    out = PROC_DIR / "tasks_tagged.jsonl"
    with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for row in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {len(rows)} rows to {out}")
    print(f"low_overlap (ratio <= {OVERLAP_THRESHOLD}): {n_low}")
    print(f"multi_capability (n_gold >= {MULTI_CAPABILITY_MIN}): {n_multi}")
    print(f"shared_name: {n_shared}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Follow-up done. Changed files: src/toolprune/task_features.py and data/processed/ only. No git, no external APIs.

1. shared_name now comes from gold_names against the catalog, including ambiguous names. It is true for 25 tasks. features.shared_name_tools maps each gold name to its tool ids.
2. Neighbours are ranked over all 527 tools per gold-side tool (every candidate of an ambiguous name). Same-name tools, same-server (cap 10), top 3 name-Jaccard, and top 8 TF-IDF are included. Each neighbour has a reasons list (same_name, same_server, name_overlap, desc_overlap). Trends Hub siblings now appear.
3. resolution_proposals (34: 29 ambiguous, 5 missing) are in tasks_tagged. gold_ids and resolution are untouched. One missing name (open_document) has no proposal.
4. All 95 tasks relabelled. 16 bucket sets changed, with prior_buckets kept. Primary changed for 1 task (83).

Counts (any / primary): multi 48/45, taxonomy 65/15, semantic 29/18, ambiguity 15/2, near_duplicate 10/3, none 12/12.
Confidence: high 40, medium 44, low 11.
Review queue: 63 tasks, each with reasons. Breakdown: 44 medium, 11 low, 28 not fully resolved, 25 ambiguous gold, 5 missing gold, 4 random 10% sample.
Note: taxonomy_collision rose from 51 to 65, mostly because the wider neighbour pool exposes siblings. Labels are still by me (Haiku 5.5), so review is needed.
